```{r load-scores}
# load data from redivis
user <- redivis::redivis$user("levante")
dataset <- user$dataset("levante_data_pilots:68kn")
scores <- dataset$table("scores:pgms")$to_tibble(
  variables = c("dataset", "task_id", "task_code", "user_id", "score", "score_se",
                "score_type", "scoring_model", "age", "time_started")
)
props <- dataset$get()$properties

# pass to OJS, along with which dataset and version the scores are from
ojs_define(data = scores,
           data_source = list(name = props$name, version = props$version$tag, url = props$url))
```
